g.title: b2_tensors
g.text: B-2's inputs, outputs and every tensor between them, for one sample
rounded: a module · square: a tensor, with its shape · grey: the release, frozen · blue: the side-car, frozen · green: what B-2 trains · dashed: training only

g.title: img
g.text: t − 0.5 s and t · rows 28–1052, resized to 512 × 256

g.title: vit
g.text: 304 M · tubelet 2 fuses the two frames · RoPE

g.title: bev
g.text: to the map at points projected from pₖ · FFN

g.title: adapter
g.text: reads qₖ₋₁, pₖ and the arm's tokens

g.title: layers
g.text: to the 512 tokens · FFN · refℓ = refℓ₋₁ + ref_mlp(aℓ)

g.title: hid
g.text: the hidden layer, per layer ℓ
B-2 reads ℓ = 6 (HD, H6) and ℓ = 3 (H3)

g.title: heads
g.text: log l, w, h, sin and cos yaw · velocity 2

g.title: tokens
g.text: the arm's tokens, and what biases attention to them
A kept agents × 18 → MLP → A × 128 · bias −clearance / 5 for each
D's tokens + LayerNorm(a₆) → 128, for each kept agent; D's bias
all 128 slots: LayerNorm(a₆) → 128, + a code of ref₆ (MLP);
as H6, with a₃ and ref₃
labelled agents in CAM_F0's view, within 50 m, as D's (confidence 1)
none: the adapter's own half only (query + pose)
a learned "no agent" slot is always there to attend to · the fold's input map, if alignment needs one

g.title: loop
g.text: p₁ is decoded before any δ: agent-blind
p₂ … p₄ follow δ₁ … δ₃; δ₄ reaches only the scorer

g.title: pool
g.text: q₄ → max over each proposal's 8 poses

g.title: plan
g.text: argmax of σ(final) → one of the 32

g.title: aux
g.text: from f: each proposal's collision and TTC agents,
from the queries: the drivable area

g.title: logits
g.text: 32 × 6: DDC, EP, TTC, LK, HC, final
only the final one is read

g.title: targets
g.text: the human's plan: 8 × 3 · up to 4 good anchors (teachers): 4 × 8 × 3
PDM labels of the 32: 32 × 9 (NC, DAC, TLC, DDC, EP, TTC, LK, HC, final)
online in B-2-1; from the dump, vendored, in B-2-2 and B-2-3
the auxiliaries' targets, from the metric cache (B-2-1)

g.title: rays
g.text: each token's ray at 16 depths, 1–60 m
→ MLP → 512 × 384, added to the keys only
